title: Project Update Meeting
one_line_summary: Team assigned tasks and set deadlines for the chat UI, API testing, and deployment while addressing a login issue blocker.
summary_points: Arman to complete new chat UI by Friday.
Rahul to test API and report bugs by Saturday.
Deployment of first version scheduled for Monday.
Login issue identified as a blocker.
Priya to investigate login issue today.
decisions: Deploy the first version on Monday.
